claim_boundary: The candidate was remotely validated but failed before native provisioning because of hosted simulator lifecycle instability. The small wall-time difference is not a meaningful improvement. Its artifacts are retained as a failed validation, and the ten-run evidence batch uses the existing published workflow at the pinned baseline commit.
